parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. The two methods — `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) — live in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` and are distinct behavioral assertions about the audio player's stop semantics.
